notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who’s been playing the Desktown Demo 💛. We’re excited to share the second — and most likely final — update for the demo! With this update, most of the features, bug fixes, and polish are done. From here, we’ll be focusing on adding more content for the full release.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684184/a400dedfda20da18b3c5d979de9e66e5cfb61f06.png"][/img][/p][p]✨[b]Decorations Can Give Resources[/b] – Placing decorations now rewards you with resources! We noticed many players skipped decorating their cities, so we hope this feature makes it both prettier [i]and[/i] more rewarding.[/p][/*][*][p]🏗 [b]Move & Destroy Areas[/b] – You can now reposition or remove entire areas by double clicking on the area that you want to move/reposition.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]UI Display Fix[/b] – Fixed an issue where the game didn’t display correctly for players with side taskbars.[/p][/*][*][p]👥 [b]Better Layer Sorting[/b] – Civilians and decorations now layer properly based on their position.[/p][/*][*][p]🛰️ [b]Satellite Word Improvements[/b] – Expanded and simplified the possible words to make guessing easier and less confusing.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 [b]Other Small Fixes[/b] – A handful of tiny improvements and bug fixes we may have forgotten to list 😅.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re now fully shifting our focus to marketing and preparing for the full release in [b]October 2025[/b] 🎉. Make sure to wishlist so you won’t miss it![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing,
[b]The Desktown Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Save File Issue — We’re Deeply Sorry.
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]We want to sincerely apologize for a critical issue in the latest patch that causes save files to be lost. Unfortunately, if you’ve already updated, your previous progress may be unrecoverable. [/p][p][b]If you haven't update the game, we highly recommend you to go to C:\\Users\[YOUR USERNAME]\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Deskteam and make a backup of the save files![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Right now, the best course of action is to reboot the game and start fresh. We know how frustrating and disappointing this is, and we're truly sorry for the inconvenience. [/p][p]We're working on a fix and will also implement a proper backup system in the next update to prevent something like this from ever happening again. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who tried out the [b]Desktown Demo[/b]! We've received tons of positive responses, insightful feedback, and helpful bug reports — and we're excited to roll out a new update that improves many parts of the game 🎉[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684184/b97fe7da9646cdc573defd55ee56cec476006ef6.png"][/img]🏙️ [b]11 New Automators[/b]: 6 in the City era and 5 in Medieval.[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ [b]Move Decorations[/b]: You can now reposition decorations after placing them.[/p][/*][*][p]📚 [b]Improved Tutorial[/b]: Clearer guidance and fewer bugs for smoother onboarding.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed overlapping decorations between areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI buttons (like the menu) not opening properly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🍗 [b]Better Food Balance[/b]: More food automators added — that annoying “Not Enough Food!” message should pop up far less now.[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Translation Improvements[/b]: Especially for [b]German, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean[/b] — no more tofu (□) characters![/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]New Music Tracks[/b]: Switched to safer, attribution-free music by [b]Loyalty Freak Music[/b] and [b]ESPC[/b] — perfect for content creators![/p][/*][*][p]🌌 [b]Satellite Typing Tip[/b]: We added a small indicator to press [b]\[SPACE][/b] when entering satellite words.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]FPS Limit Option[/b]: You can now cap the framerate.[/p][/*][/list][p]...and more tiny improvements we might've forgotten 😅[/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, and we’re super thankful to have such a great community of players 💛. We’re planning to participate in more festivals, grow our content marketing, and move closer to finalizing the demo![/p][p]Stay tuned,
[b]The Desktown Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Desktown's Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]After a long time of development, we're happy to announce that [b]Desktown's demo is now out on Steam![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3898960/Desktown_Demo"][/dynamiclink]You can have a taste of the game with its areas, automators, decorations, satellites, and many others! Though they're more limited compared to the full version.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the demo, consider [b]leaving a review and wishlist [/b]the game so you won't miss the full release! And if you have any suggestions or bug report, you could [b]let us now through our Discord Server[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/m34qA5wjQU"]https://discord.gg/m34qA5wjQU[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks and enjoy![/b][/p]
